recommendation: Keep the core-source fix. If the work group wants current THO default expansions to omit notSelectable roots despite UP-528, that should be handled as a THO/UTG follow-up rather than by changing this FHIR-core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-17638 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It reported that the v3 PurposeOfUse value set expansion exposed the abstract/root PurposeOfUse concept as if it were an implementable code, particularly for bindings such as Consent.purpose, and resolved to exclude the abstract code while pursuing broader R5 handling for abstract/not-selectable codes in expansions.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17638 was found. The historical v3 MIF source in tools/tx/v3/source.xml now has codeBasedContent includeHeadCode="false" for the PurposeOfUse value set, and 2018 Conformance/MnM minutes record approvals to drop the abstract root and treat the value set as ActReason-based.
additional_context: Current FHIR core bindings point to the external THO ValueSet/v3-PurposeOfUse. THO 7.1.0 defines that value set over CodeSystem/v3-ActReason, marks the PurposeOfUse concept notSelectable, and has no CodeSystem-v3-PurposeOfUse resource. Later implemented UP-528 and its Zulip discussion intentionally removed the old value-set exclusion after marking the code notSelectable to support hierarchy rendering, and core $expand documentation now describes excludeNotForUI for notSelectable concepts.
reconciliation: Changed source/security-labels.html so the active Security Labels narrative identifies the Purpose of Use coding system as http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActReason while retaining the link to the PurposeOfUse value set. No v3 expansion artifact was edited because current expansion behavior is governed by THO/UTG and later notSelectable decisions.
